Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses affinity purification (anti-Flag beads) to isolate translation products of modified mRNAs, followed by trypsin digestion and DDA-MS on a Q Exactive HF. No specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or ubiquitin) was performed; the 'acetylation' mentioned is a standard variable modification for search parameters, not an enrichment strategy.

scope: Flag-eGFP peptides translated in HEK293T cells were purified with anti-Flag M2 magnetic beads (Sigma, M8823).
Pulled down proteins were extensively washed with 50 mM ammonium acetate and were directly digested on the beads.
For each modification, the translated peptides from the bacterial and eukaryotic systems were purified and analyzed by mass spectrometry (MS)

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS consisted of translation products (Flag-eGFP) purified via anti-Flag M2 magnetic beads (affinity capture) or purified bacterial translation products via Vivaspin columns.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses non-standard nucleotides as chemical perturbations to the mRNA template to analyze translation efficiency and accuracy. While these are nucleotide modifications, they act as the primary biological variable (perturbation) differentiating the experimental groups. No specific L2 class in the ontology perfectly matches 'nucleotide analog substitution', so the broad 'chemical_or_drug' category is used.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment uses DDA (Q Exactive HF) and focuses on identifying the amino acid sequence of translation products from modified mRNAs. While no complex labeling is mentioned, the goal is to identify which amino acids were incorporated, typically handled by standard DDA search pipelines.

workflow: Peptides were analyzed using a Dionex, UltiMate 3000 nano-HPLC system coupled via nanospray ionization source to a Thermo Scientific Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer
Database search was performed using ProteomeDiscoverer (Version 2.1, Thermo Scientific) with search engine Sequest HT
differential: the interpretation of these RNA nucleobase derivatives by the ribosomal decoding site was also determined
the translated peptides from the bacterial and eukaryotic systems were purified and analyzed by mass spectrometry
search_parameters: Fixed modification was carbamidomethylcysteine; variable modifications were N-terminal protein acetylation and methionine oxidation
Enzyme for protein cleavage was trypsin; two missed cleavages were allowed
Precursor mass tolerance was set to 10 ppm; fragment mass tolerance was 20 mmu

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment is primarily a sequence identification study to determine how non-standard nucleotides are decoded into amino acids. The search included 21 custom ErmCL protein sequences in the database to account for the modified translation products.
